messages:
sanjay: Uh oh, CI on main turned red after my merge (PR #8422). pre-commit failed with rustfmt + mypy. anyone around?

ci-bot: pre-commit run results: FAIL

ci-bot: job: build/test-main #432

sanjay: Pasting the failing bits:
```
pre-commit run --all-files
repos: ...
- hook id: rustfmt
  fail: yes
  files: src/runtime/kv_cache.rs
  stdout: "Diff in src/runtime/kv_cache.rs: ...\n- pub fn compact_cache(...){\n+ pub fn compact_cache(...) {\n  ..."
- hook id: mypy
  fail: yes
  stdout: "src/serve/handler.py:120: error: Incompatible return value type (got 'None', expected 'Response')"
```

emma: thanks, looking. Is that mypy error from the new `Response` refactor? I remember a similar change in #8380.

sanjay: yeah I updated the handler return types but maybe missed one path. I can patch. rustfmt diff is weird though, I didn't touch kv_cache.rs. @jules any recent rustfmt config changes?

jules: I bumped `rustfmt` in pre-commit to 1.6.0 yesterday to align with toolchains. Might cause formatting diffs on existing files. Sorry, should've noted.

ryan: quick triage plan: 1) sanjay re-run `pre-commit run rustfmt --files src/runtime/kv_cache.rs` locally and commit formatting if OK; 2) sanjay push small mypy fix; 3) if tests still red, request CI re-run, else we merge. If the rustfmt change causes many diffs we can pin or revert.

sanjay: running now...

sanjay: local run fixed kv_cache.rs formatting, but mypy still fails in handler.py. Here's the failing line:
```
async def handle(req) -> Response | None:
    if not authorized(req):
        return None
    return await process(req)
```
mypy says `return None` incompatible with `Response`. Should be `Optional[Response]` in annotation.
```

emma: yeah change signature to `-> Optional[Response]` and update callers. Probably need `from typing import Optional`.

sanjay: made the change, pushed. CI queued.

ci-bot: job build/test-main #433 started

ci-bot: job build/test-main #433 completed: FAILED

ci-bot: failure summary: mypy error new file src/serve/router.py:88: error: Argument 1 to "wrap" has incompatible type "Handler[Request, Response | None]"; expected "Handler[Request, Response]"

ryan: looks like router expects handlers to always return Response. Might be safer to make handler always return Response and have it produce a 401 response instead of None. That preserves the handler type.

sanjay: ok I'll convert the None -> make_unauthorized_response() and keep type as Response. Pushing shortly.

sanjay: done, pushed. Also ran `pre-commit run --all-files` locally, clean.

ci-bot: job build/test-main #434 started

ci-bot: job build/test-main #434 completed: PASSED :tada:

emma: nice! thanks for the quick turnaround. For future: call out pre-commit tool bumps in PR body so infra has a heads up.

jules: noted, will add a checklist item.

sanjay: thanks all. If anything flakes again, ping me and I'll bisect.

ryan: optional: if anyone sees more formatting diffs across many files, we should run a mass `git ls-files | xargs pre-commit run --files` and create a formatting PR.

emma: @sanjay can you open a short follow-up PR to pin rustfmt in pre-commit config to avoid surprises for older branches?

sanjay: will do tomorrow morning. Closing the incident for now.
